products.product_description: Fudge Brownie Collagen Protein Bar. Each bar is packed in foil wrapper, net wt. per bar 1.58 oz (45g). There 12 bars packed in a box and the net wt. per box is 18.96 oz (540g). Individual Bar UPC 815709021498. Box UPC 815709020811.
products.reason_for_recall: Fudge Brownie Collagen Protein Bar product is recalled because it has the potential to be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes.
